references.text: The same introductory formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, a common introduction to divine revelations in the books of Moses.
An identical introductory formula at the beginning of Leviticus, showing the repeated way God communicates his laws to Moses.
The same phrase 'the Lord spoke to Moses and said' that introduces new sections of legislation in Leviticus.
A parallel introduction to a new set of regulations, illustrating the structure of the Levitical lawgiving.
A similar opening verse in Numbers where the Lord speaks to Moses, confirming Moses' role as mediator of God's word.
Another occurrence of the standardized formula for divine revelation to Moses.
